verdict.rationale: Lorikeet publishes an official MCP server (docs.lorikeetcx.ai/mcp/mcp-server) that lets Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, and MintMCP connect directly to a Lorikeet account, with documented capabilities like diagnosing tickets, auditing knowledge bases, building workflows, testing tools, and running simulations via MCP. This is confirmed live (HTTP 200) via probe evidence, not just marketing copy. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server working end-to-end, and no community reports corroborating reliability.
